title: Kounga Ataata 360p, 720p, 1080p: He Aha te Rerekētanga?
description: He aha te rerekētanga o te kounga ataata 360p, 720p me te 1080p? Ako ai i te tikanga o te taumira, tōna pānga ki te rahi kōnae, me te kōwhiri mō tō waea.
photo2Caption: He maha ake ngā taipitopito ka puritia e te 1080p.
body:
Ina tikiake ataata koe, i te nuinga o te wā ka hoatu ki a koe ētahi kōwhiringa pērā i te 360p, te 720p me te 1080p. Nā, ko tēhea me kōwhiri? Ka whakamārama tēnei tuhinga i te rerekētanga o te kounga ataata 360p, 720p me te 1080p mā te reo māmā, kia taea ai e koe te kōwhiri i te taumira e hāngai ana ki ō hiahia, ki ō raraunga me te rokiroki o tō waea.

He aha te tikanga o ngā tau 360p, 720p me te 1080p?

Ko aua tau e tohu ana i te taumira, arā, te maha o ngā rārangi pika i te taha poto o te ataata. Ka piki te tau, ka maha ake ngā taipitopito ka taea te whakaatu. Ko te pū “p” nō te progressive scan, he tikanga whakaatu pikitia e whakamahia whānuitia ana i ngā ataata matihiko.

  • 360p: tata ki te 640 × 360 pika mō te ataata whakapae. He kounga paerewa iti.
  • 720p: tata ki te 1280 × 720 pika, e kīia ana ko te HD.
  • 1080p: tata ki te 1920 × 1080 pika, e mōhiotia ana ko te Full HD.

Mō ngā ataata poutū, pērā i te nuinga e rere ana i ngā pāpāho pāpori, ka hurihia whakamuri ngā inenga. Hei tauira, tata ki te 1080 × 1920 pika te rahi o tētahi ataata poutū 1080p.

Te rerekētanga o te kounga ataata 360p, 720p me te 1080p i te mahi

360p: he iti te whakapau raraunga me te rokiroki

Ko tēnei taumira ka hua mai ko te kōnae iti rawa. He mārama tonu te pikitia i te mata iti o te waea, engari ka āhua kōmeme pea te kuputuhi iti me ngā taipitopito o te kanohi. He pai mēnā ko tō hiahia noa he tiaki i tētahi ataata whakakatakata hei mātakitaki poto, i te wā rānei kua tata pau ō raraunga ipurangi.

720p: te kōwhiringa taurite

Ki te tini, ko te 720p te waenga tika. He koi tonu te pikitia i te mata waea, ā, he māmā ake tonu te rahi o te kōnae i te 1080p. He pai tēnei kōwhiringa mō ngā akoranga, ngā tohutao, me ngā ataata e hiahia ana koe ki te mātakitaki anō i ētahi wā.

1080p: te mea koi rawa

Mēnā he mea nui ngā taipitopito, hei tauira, he ataata whenua ātaahua, he akoranga e whakaatu ana i te kuputuhi iti, he ataata rānei ka mātakitakina i te papahiko, i te rorohiko, i te pouaka whakaata rānei, kōwhiria te 1080p. Ko te hua, ka rahi ake te kōnae, ā, ka roa ake te tikiake.

Te rahi o te kōnae me ngā raraunga

Hei kōrero whānui, ka piki te taumira, ka rahi ake te kōnae. Heoi anō, ka pāngia hoki te rahi tūturu e te roanga, e te nui o te nekeneke i roto i te ataata, me te āhua o te kōpēhi o te ataata. Ka rerekē pea te rahi o ētahi ataata e rua he ōrite te roanga. Nō reira, kaua e matapae tau, me pupuri noa i tēnei ture māmā: mēnā he iti tō rokiroki, ō raraunga rānei, whakahekea te taumira.

Me pēhea te kōwhiri kounga ina tikiake

I I Need Save, he tino māmā te kōwhiri kounga:

  1. I te taupānga pāpāho pāpori, pātōtia Share (Tiri), kātahi ko Copy link (Tārua hono).
  2. Huakina te ineedsave.com, ka whakapiri i te hono ki te pouaka, pātōtia rānei te Whakapiri.
  3. Pēhia Tikiake.
  4. Tirohia te rārangi kōwhiringa ataata ka puta, kātahi ka kōwhiri i te taumira e hiahia ana koe.

Ka whakawhirinaki ngā kōwhiringa e wātea ana ki te pou taketake. He ataata ētahi he kōwhiringa mai i te 360p ki te 1080p, ā, ko ētahi he kounga kotahi, e rua rānei anake. Mēnā ka whakaatu te pātene i te E whakarite ana…, tatari mō te wā poto; kei te tukatukahia te ataata, ā, ka tīmata aunoa te tikiake.

Mā te kōwhiri i te 1080p, kāore e taea te whakakoi i tētahi ataata i kōmeme mai i te tīmatanga. Kāore te kounga o te kōnae ka tikiakehia e pai ake i te ataata i tukuna e te kaihanga.

Pēhea ngā codec HEVC me H.264?

Hāunga te taumira, he mea anō ka pā ki te tākaro māeneene o tētahi ataata, arā, ko te codec. Ka whakamahi ētahi ataata TikTok i te codec HEVC (H.265). He whai hua tēnei hōputu, engari tērā pea kāore e taea e ngā waea tawhito rawa te whakatangi māeneene. Ka tākaro te kōwhiringa H.264 i te nuinga o ngā pūrere. Nō reira, mēnā ka tūtatuta te ataata i tētahi waea tawhito, ngana ki te tikiake anō mā tētahi atu kōwhiringa e wātea ana. Kei te tuhinga mō ngā ataata kua tikiakehia kāore e tākaro te aratohu katoa.

Ko te oro anake tāu e hiahia ana?

Mēnā ko te puoro, ko te oro rānei anake o te ataata tāu e hiahia ana, kāore he take o te tikiake i te ataata 1080p. Kōwhiria te kōwhiringa Oro, i te kounga taketake, he MP3 192 kbps rānei kua hurihia mai i te ataata. He iti kē atu te rahi i te nuinga o te wā, ā, ka taea te whakatangi tika i tētahi taupānga puoro. Kei te aratohu mō te huri ataata pāpāho pāpori hei MP3 te whakamārama.

Ahakoa he aha te kounga ka kōwhiria e koe, whakamahia ngā ataata kua tikiakehia mō tō ake whakamahinga anake, ā, whakautetia te mana pupuri o te kaihanga. Tonoa he whakaaetanga i mua i te tuku anō, ā, whakaingoatia te kaihanga.

Ngā pātai auau

Ko tēhea kounga e tino tūtohungia ana?

Mō te mātakitaki i te waea, i te nuinga o te wā ka nui te 720p. Kōwhiria te 1080p mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te mātakitaki i tētahi mata nui, ā, ko te 360p mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te penapena rokiroki.

He aha i kore ai he kōwhiringa 1080p?

Ka whai ngā kōwhiringa kounga i te ataata taketake. Mēnā i tukuna e te kaihanga i tētahi taumira iti iho, ko ētahi kounga anake rānei ka tukuna e te pūhara, kāore te kōwhiringa 1080p e puta.

He roa ake te tikiake i ngā ataata 1080p?

I te nuinga o te wā, āe, nā te mea he rahi ake te kōnae. Ka whakawhirinaki hoki te tere ki tō hononga ipurangi.
